page.notes: The Syriac (Nestorian script) is not legible enough on this scan to copy letter by letter, so each Syriac word or line is marked illegible with an estimated letter count. The Syriac lines are quotations of the definition of "Sciul" (Sheol) and "Gehenna" and are not transcribed. The first line of the page continues from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". Printed spelling kept: "Hebed-" and "iesu" split across the line end, the long s rendered as s, and the initial letter of the first line ("ftat") is a damaged "s" from the start of the word "stat".
